t: Lonza To Buy Arch Chemicals
s: October 23, 2014 - Lonza expects $50 million in annual cost savings, largely by eliminating redundant administrative functions. Taking advantage of the strong Swiss franc, it will finance the purchase entirely through debt. After buying Arch stock—at a 37% premium to the firm’s recent share price—and getting regulatory approvals, Lonza hopes to close the deal later this year.
